name: flags
description: Manage feature flags served by the feature-flags plugin: list, get, set, history, canary rollouts and kill switches.
author: nself
notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: no port, no HTTP server, no database tables. `nself plugin install flags` places the built nself-flags binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/, where ProxyCommand execs it for `nself flags <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from the CLI core under CLI-R11. This is a client for the feature-flags plugin and does nothing without it, so it ships alongside rather than in the core binary.
